# peakhour_bulk_redirect_entry (Resource)

Manages an entry in a bulk redirect list for a domain.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "peakhour_bulk_redirect_entry" "example" {
  domain             = "example.com"
  bulk_redirect_uuid = "11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111"
  source_path        = "/old-page"
  target_url         = "https://example.com/new-page"
  status_code        = 301
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `bulk_redirect_uuid` (String) Bulk redirect list UUID.
- `domain` (String) Domain name.
- `source_path` (String) Path to match for redirect (e.g. /old-page).
- `target_url` (String) Full URL to redirect to.

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Enable/disable this redirect entry.
- `preserve_query_string` (Boolean) Preserve query string from source URL.
- `source_domain` (String) Domain to match (e.g. www.example.com).
- `source_scheme` (String) Scheme to match (e.g. http or https).
- `status_code` (Number) HTTP status code for the redirect (301, 302, 307, 308).

### Read-Only

- `entry_id` (String) Entry identifier (computed after creation).
- `id` (String) Bulk redirect entry identifier (domain/bulk_redirects/uuid/entries/entry_id).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import peakhour_bulk_redirect_entry.example example.com/bulk_redirects/11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111/entries/42
```
